answer: ОТВЕТ (гипотеза): Diversity in Pottery Form обрушивается, а Diversity in Pottery Decoration одновременно растёт в 17-м веке до н.э. — столетнем бине CE −1700…−1601 (1700–1601 BCE; бин, начинающийся в CE −1700 = 1700 BCE). В сырых z-данных это единственный бин, где форма проваливается (z: +0.74 → −1.13, Δz ≈ −1.87, плато −1.13 держится 13 столетий до −500), а декор в тот же бин подскакивает (z: −0.48 → +0.97, Δz ≈ +1.45). Результат устойчив к порогам по форме и подтверждается независимым сглаживанием годовой интерполированной серии (rolling mean 100 лет). Контраст для уникальности: второй скачок декора на CE −1000 (+0.56, до z = 1.53) происходит при неизменной форме (−1.13) — он не синхронен ни с каким движением формы; а другой крупный сдвиг формы (−2900→−2800, 1.27→0.37) сопровождается падением декора, а не ростом.

payload.hypothesis: Diversity in Pottery Form collapses and Diversity in Pottery Decoration simultaneously increases in the 17th century BCE — the century bin CE −1700 to −1601 (1700–1601 BCE). At that bin PotteryForm drops from z = +0.74 to z = −1.13 (Δz ≈ −1.87) and stays on this plateau for 13 centuries (to CE −500), while PotteryDecoration jumps from z = −0.48 to z = +0.97 (Δz ≈ +1.45) in the same century. This is the unique century in the 37-bin series (CE −4100…−500) where a form collapse (|Δz| ≥ 1, level crossing zero downward, sustained ≥ 3 centuries) coincides with a decoration increase (|Δz| ≥ 1, level crossing zero upward, sustained ≥ 3 centuries); the result is stable to threshold choices and reproduced by a 100-year rolling mean on the annual interpolated series. The later decoration rise at CE −1000 (+0.56, to z = 1.53) is NOT simultaneous (form unchanged at −1.13), and the other large form shift (−2900 → −2800) is accompanied by a decoration decrease, not an increase.
payload.workflow: 1) Loaded and cross-validated three CSVs: time_series_data.csv (3601 annual rows, CE −4100…−500; raw PotteryForm/PotteryDecoration at 37 century marks, piecewise-constant; _inter annual, 0 NaN; CE+calBP=1950 check passed), capital.csv (BCE 500–4300, decimal=',', CE=−BCE; values identical to time_series at all 37 overlapping years, max abs diff 0.0), pollen file (context only, coverage ends CE −702, not used for dating). 2) Unit of analysis: 100-year bins matching native resolution of the raw z series. 3) Formal detection: collapse = Δz ≤ −1.0 vs previous bin AND level < 0 AND sustained ≥ 3 centuries; increase = Δz ≥ +1.0 AND level > 0 AND sustained ≥ 3 centuries. 4) Simultaneity = same century bin is both events; fallback = overlapping event intervals. 5) Sensitivity grid (Δz 1.0/1.5 × sustain 3/5) — no configuration yields any other simultaneous bin. 6) Independent cross-check: 100-year centered rolling mean on annual PotteryForm_inter/PotteryDecoration_inter — largest form drop at bin −1700 with decoration rising (+0.706); first CE with rolling decoration > +0.5 is −1730, inside the −1700 bin. 7) Full inventory of all 37 bins saved to pottery_bins_table.csv showing uniqueness of the −1700 event.
payload.sensitivity: unique simultaneous bin [-1700] for dz>=1.0 with sustain 3 or 5; at dz>=1.5 form still collapses at -1700 (dz=-1.87), decoration increase (+1.45) falls below threshold — no other candidate bin in any configuration
